shortDescription: South African state power utility Eskom said Calib Cassim would retire as the group's Chief Financial Officer, effective Saturday.Eskom announced the retirement earlier in August, saying he would retire during the financial year ending March 2027.

children: South African state power utility Eskom said Calib Cassim would retire as the group's Chief Financial Officer, effective Saturday.
Eskom announced the retirement earlier in August, saying he would retire during the financial year ending March 2027.
